baseline.description: Validator aims at providing all composition errors, which were generated while composing the stage.
Stages that can be consumed as referenceable assets must have a valid 'defaultPrim' specified.
All stages must declare their 'upAxis' and 'metersPerUnit'.
Validates there are no nested Gprims.
Validates that GeomSubset prims are direct descendants of an Imageable prim.
Validates all of the geom subset families authored beneath an Imageable prim.
All properties named 'material:binding' or in that namespace should be relationships.
Verify a prim has the MaterialBindingAPI applied if it has a material binding relationship.
Verify that a collection defining a material binding is well-formed
Geom subsets with authored material bindings should have the 'materialBind' family name.
Geom subsets of the 'materialBind' family should have a restricted family type.

Connectable prims (e.g. Shader, Material, etc) can only be nested inside other Container-like Connectable prims. Container-like prims include Material, NodeGraph, Light, LightFilter. Shader is not a Container-like prim.
The composed USD stage should not contain any unresolvable asset dependencies (in every possible variation of the asset), when using the default asset resolver.
Validates all of the UsdPhysicsRigidBodyAPIs applied to a prim.
Validates all of the UsdPhysicsCollisionAPIs applied to a prim.
Validates all of the UsdPhysicsJoint prims.
Validates all of the UsdPhysicsArticulationRootAPIs applied to a prim.
Validate the topology of a mesh on all time samples.

Boundable prims have the extent attribute. For point based prims, the value of the extent must be correct at each
    time sample of the point attribute

Check that all normals have unit length, and that there are no non-finite values.
    Also checks that the supplied number of normal values agrees with the interpolation.

Check that meshes have normals. All meshes should have normals
    unless they have the subdivision scheme set. Meshes cannot have
    both normals and subdivision set.

Check that the mesh has normals that are consistent with the face windings,
    taking into account the 'orientation' attribute.

    We define the meaning of agreement between a normal attribute value and the
    reference normal of a face (quite loosely) as the two having a positive inner product.
    We then sum these inner products, and if the sum is positive, it would be a relatively
    large number (close to the area of the surface) and this would indicate that the winding
    is right-handed. Otherwise, the sum would be a relatively large negative number to
    indicate a left-handed rule having been used for generation of normals.

    Works on non time varying geometry.

Faces with zero area can be removed. May produce welding after removal.

    Works on non time varying geometry.
Rule ensuring that the bound material exists in the scene.
Check referenced local dependency files are present.
Decode discovered image files within byte/pixel limits; no UV or visual comparison.
Inspect authored transform samples, boundaries and midpoints for usable timing and finite values; no intended path or continuous guarantee.

configurable_checks.coverage: Named native validator scope
limitations: Local USD admission limits apply.

configurable_checks.coverage: Existing cube/polygon/edit/evidence scope
limitations: Fixed topology/indexing for shape preservation; no collision or rendering

configurable_checks.description: Check resolved bindings, shader IDs and external files
configurable_checks.coverage: Named material structure and dependency existence
limitations: No rendered appearance, image decoding, UV correctness or physical parameters

configurable_checks.description: Compare world origins at explicit time codes
configurable_checks.coverage: Only named positions at supplied times
limitations: No continuous-time guarantee, collision, orientation or physics

configurable_checks.description: Run explicit NVIDIA rules without fixes
configurable_checks.coverage: Named upstream rules only
limitations: No simulator execution or SimReady profile certification

configurable_checks.description: Check authored stage duration and optionally require an exact clock rate
configurable_checks.coverage: Authored stage time range converted to seconds
limitations: Does not infer active motion duration; an authored positive timeCodesPerSecond or framesPerSecond rate and complete time range are required

configurable_checks.description: Compare named world origins at elapsed seconds from the authored stage start
configurable_checks.coverage: Named world origins at the requested elapsed seconds
limitations: Tolerance is per coordinate in metres, not Euclidean distance
No continuous-time, orientation, collision or physics proof
Requires authored clock rate (including FPS fallback) and time range

configurable_checks.description: Verify and load one required image
configurable_checks.coverage: Selected static image bytes
limitations: No UV, color-management, rendered appearance or hostile-input isolation claim

configurable_checks.description: Compare the gap between two task-named points
configurable_checks.coverage: World-space distances at explicit times
limitations: Points are caller-defined, not inferred joints; finite sampling can miss motion defects

configurable_checks.description: Run the fixed incline model and compare displacement
configurable_checks.coverage: A one-body CPU experiment and its execution record
limitations: Fixed fixture profile; no general USD physics importer or hostile-code sandbox
Assumed friction does not establish real-world task validity

configurable_checks.coverage: Admitted external dependencies; missing MDL source assets are unknown unless local delivery is explicitly required
Discovered image files; other formats remain unknown
Explicitly bounded samples; no motion intent
Explicit named comparison; see docs/SUPPLEMENTAL_CHECKS.md for every fixed target.
limitations: Fixed four-job paths, targets and tolerances; selecting a job explicitly adopts that scope.

Preservation compares root-layer authored fields; it does not prove composed dependency equivalence.

configurable_checks.coverage: Selected authored metadata fields
limitations: No active motion or world-coordinate interpretation claim

configurable_checks.coverage: World Cube/Mesh bounds at one time
limitations: No shape equivalence

configurable_checks.coverage: One parent and type
limitations: Count does not establish function or dimensions

configurable_checks.coverage: Two named Cube/Mesh world bounding boxes
limitations: Not a walkability or safety test

configurable_checks.description: Delivered texture matches a reference image
configurable_checks.coverage: Declared regions/mask of static decoded RGB source pixels
limitations: Does not prove rendered appearance; excluded pixels are not accepted

configurable_checks.description: Require two held state attributes to agree, optionally while an occupancy attribute is true
configurable_checks.coverage: Named USD token/string/bool state over every authored transition and the final endpoint
limitations: Not a continuous geometry or physics proof
Reference and activation state must be supplied and justified by the caller

configurable_checks.description: Compare tagged equipment and directed port relationships
configurable_checks.coverage: Declared static equipment/port metadata and connection-list agreement
limitations: A correct graph is not process fitness or physical connectivity proof
